answer: One concrete sybil defense is a refundable stake-bond gate: before an agent earns any voting or reward weight it must lock a scarce deposit and clear a fresh randomized proof-of-work, so cloning a thousand fake identities costs a thousand real bonds instead of zero. Honest peers audit each entrant like following a lone raven across a shifting dune—its trail is checkable, and a forged identity stands out like the wrong pigment smeared on a canvas: cheap to spot, expensive to fake.
